senses.gloss:
कुत् कुत् (a Sautra root, or one found in
grammatical Sūtras only), to spread.

कुत कुत, अस्, m., N. of one of the eighteen
attendants of the sun, identified with the god of the
ocean.

कुतनय कु-तनय, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a de-
generate son.

कुतनु कु-तनु, उस्, वी, उ (see 1. कु), de-
formed; (उस्), m. an epithet of Kuvera or Kubera
(this deity being of a monstrous appearance, having
three legs and but eight teeth; see कुबेर).

कुतप कु-तप, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. कु), slightly
hot, mild, tepid; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a sort of blanket
made of the hair of the mountain-goat; the eighth
Muhūrta or portion of the day from the last
Daṇḍa of the second watch to the first of the third
or about noon; an eligible time for the performance
of sacrifices to the manes; a kind of sacrificial grass,
Poa Cynosuroides; grain; a daughter's son; a
sister's son; a twice-born man, one of the first three
classes; a Brāhman; a guest; the sun; fire; an
ox; a musical instrument.
—कुतप-सप्तक, अम्,
n. a Śrāddha in which seven constituents occur, viz.
noon, a horn platter, a Nepal blanket, silver, sacrificial
grass, Sesamum, and Kine.

कुतपस्विन् कु-तपस्विन्, ई, m. (see 1. कु), a
wicked or bad ascetic.

कुतर्क कु-तर्क, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), falla-
cious argument, sophistry, fallacy, sophism.
—कु-
[]
तर्क-पथ, अस्, m. the way of sophists, i. e. a
sophistical method of arguing.

कुतस् कुतस्, ind. (fr. 1. कु), from where?
whence? from whence? whereto? where? in which
direction? wherefore? why? from what cause or
motive? because; how? in what manner? in which
way? how much less? much less. कुतस् is used
sometimes for the abl. case of 2. क = कस्मात् (e. g.
कुतः कालात्, since what time?). In अ-कुतस्, which
occurs at the beginning of some compounds, कुतस्
has an indefinite sense (e. g. अकुतो-मृत्यु, not
fearing death from any quarter; cf. अकुतो-भय);
कुतस् is also indefinite when connected with the
particles अपि, चिद्, and चन (e. g. कुतो ऽपि, from
any quarter, from any cause; कुतश्चिद्, from any
one, from anywhere; अकुतश्चिद्-भय, not fearing
danger from any quarter, not presenting danger on any
side; कुतश् चन, (in Ved.) from no side, to no side;
यतः कुतश्चिद्, from any person soever).
—कुतस्-
तराम्, ind. how? in what manner?
—कुतो-नि-
मित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having what cause or reason?
—कुतो-मूल, अस्, आ, अम्, having what origin?

कुतस्त्य, अस्, आ, अम्, whence come? how hap-
pened?

कुतापस कु-तापस, अस्, ई, m. f. (see 1. कु),
a wicked ascetic.

कुतित्तिरि कु-तित्तिरि, इस्, m. (see 1. कु), a
species of bird resembling the partridge.

कुतीपाद कुतीपाद, अस्, m., N. of one of the
Ṛṣis or poets of the Sāma-veda.

कुतीर्थ कु-तीर्थ, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a bad
teacher.

कुतुक कुतुक, अम्, n. eagerness, vehe-
mence; desire, inclination; curiosity; [cf. कौतुक
and कुतूहल.]

कुतुप कुतुप, अस्, m. a small leathern oil-
bottle [cf. कुतू]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the eighth Mu-
hūrta or portion of the day from the last Daṇḍa of
the second watch to the first of the third or about
noon; an eligible time for the performance of sacri-
fices to the manes; [cf. कु-तप.]
कुतू, ऊस्, f. a leathern oil-bottle.

कुतूणक कुतूणक, अस्, m. weakness of the
eyes, a disease of the eyes in infants; [cf. कुकू-
णक.]

कुतूहल कुतूहल, अम्, n. (fr. the interroga-
tive adv. कुतस् and हल, calling out?), curiosity,
interest in any extraordinary matter; desire, in-
clination; eagerness, vehemence, impetuosity; what
excites curiosity or interest, anything interesting,
fun; (अस्, आ, अम्), surprising, wonderful; excellent,
best, praised, celebrated; [cf. कौतूहल.]
—कुतू-
हल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, curious, taking an interest in
anything.

कुतूहलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, curious, highly interested in
any extraordinary matter, inquisitive; eager, im-
patient.

कुतृण कु-तृण, अम्, n. (see 1. कु), an
aquatic plant, water house-leek, Pistia Stratiotes.

कुत्थ कुत्थ, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), the
fifteenth Yoga (in astronomy).

कुत्र कुत्र, ind. (fr. 1. कु), where? where-
to? in which case? when? कुत्र — क्व, where
(this) — where (that), i. e. how distant or how dif-
ferent is this from that, how little is this consistent
with that? कुत्र becomes indefinite when con-
nected with the particles अपि, चिद्, चन, e. g.
कुत्रापि, anywhere, somewhere, to any place where-
soever; कुत्र चिद्, anywhere, somewhere, whereso-
ever, wherever, to any place; (sometimes कुत्र
चिद् = कस्मिंश्चिद्, e. g. कुत्र चिद् अरण्ये, in a
certain wood); न कुत्र चिद्, nowhere, to no place
whatsoever; कुत्र चिद् — कुत्र चिद्, in one case —
[]
in the other case; sometimes — sometimes; यत्र
कुत्र च or यत्र कुत्र चिद्, wherever it be, here
or there.

कुत्रत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, where being? where living
or residing?

कुत्स् कुत्स् (perhaps related to कुतस्), cl.
10. P. A. कुत्सयति, -ते, -यितुम्; rarely
cl. 1. P. कुत्सति, to despise, abuse, revile, contemn;
[cf. Lith. kussinu.]

कुत्सन, अस्, आ, अम्, reviling, abusive, contemp-
tuous; (अम्), n. abuse, reviling, contempt, reproach;
reproachful or abusive language; (आ), f. contemning,
expression of contempt.

कुत्सा, f. reproach, contempt, censure.
—कुत्सा-
वादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, censorious, abusive.

कुत्स कुत्स, अस्, m., N. of a Ṛṣi with the
epithet Ārjuneya, author of several hymns of the
Ṛg-veda (when attacked by the demon Śuṣṇa,
Indra defended him and killed the demon; but in
other hymns of the Ṛg-veda, Kutsa is represented as
persecuted by Indra); N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras,
author of several other hymns of the Ṛg-veda;
(pl.) the descendants or the family of Kutsa; light-
ning, thunderbolt; [cf. कौत्स, पुरु-कुत्स, &c.]
—कुत्स-कुशिकिका, f. the intermarriage of the
Kutsa and Kuśika families.
—कुत्स-पुत्र or कुत्स-
वत्स, अस्, m. a son of Kutsa.

कुत्सित, अस्, आ, अम्, despised, contemned, reviled;
contemptible, low, mean, vile, hateful; (अम्), n., N.
of a grass, Cyperus.
—कुत्सित-त्व, अम्, n. meanness,
vileness.

1. कुत्स्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be reproached, reviled,
abused; blamable.

कुत्सला कुत्सला, f. the indigo plant; [cf.
नीली.]
कु-तन्त्री, ईस् or ई, f. a tail.
